sv.title: Grevens miss: Blandade ihop von Blixen med frun
sv.summary: Greven blandade ihop hovdamen Kirstine von Blixen-Finecke – med sin döda hustru. Det säger Axel Calissendorff, grevens sista advokat, i rätten. – Några gånger sa han ”Alice” när han talade med Kinne, berättar han.

en.title: Count's slip: Confused von Blixen with his wife
en.summary: The count confused lady-in-waiting Kirstine von Blixen-Finecke with his late wife. This is what Axel Calissendorff, the count's last lawyer, says in court. "A few times he said 'Alice' when he spoke with Kinne, he recounts."
